class.name: RosGoalHandle
class.brief_description: A handle that tracks the lifecycle of a goal sent through a [RosActionClient].
class.description: [RosGoalHandle] is returned by [method RosActionClient.send_goal] and behaves like a promise: you can poll it with [method is_completed] and [method get_result], or connect to (and [code]await[/code]) its signals. All signals are emitted on the Godot main thread, so it is always safe to touch the scene tree from their handlers. The typical lifecycle is: [signal accepted] (or [signal rejected]) → zero or more [signal feedback] emissions → [signal completed] with the final result and status. [b]Note:[/b] If the goal is rejected by the server, [signal completed] is still emitted (with a [code]null[/code] result and [constant STATUS_UNKNOWN]) so that [code]await handle.completed[/code] never hangs.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Asks the server to cancel this goal. Cancellation is cooperative: the server decides when (and whether) to stop. The outcome still arrives through [signal completed], with [constant STATUS_CANCELED] if the cancellation was honored.

method.name: get_result
method.description: Returns the result message once the goal has completed, or [code]null[/code] before completion (and for rejected goals).

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns the terminal status of the goal as one of the [enum Status] constants. Before completion this is [constant STATUS_UNKNOWN].

method.name: is_accepted
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the server has accepted the goal.

method.name: is_completed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the goal has reached a terminal state and the result is available through [method get_result].

signal.name: accepted
signal.description: Emitted when the server accepts the goal and starts executing it.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted when the goal reaches a terminal state. [param result] holds the action result message ([code]null[/code] if the goal was rejected) and [param status] is one of the [enum Status] constants.

signal.name: feedback
signal.description: Emitted every time the server publishes feedback for this goal.

signal.name: rejected
signal.description: Emitted when the server rejects the goal. [signal completed] follows immediately with a [code]null[/code] result.

constants.constant: The goal has no terminal status yet (still executing), or it was rejected by the server.
The server aborted the goal. Matches [code]action_msgs/GoalStatus.STATUS_ABORTED[/code].
The goal was canceled after a cancel request. Matches [code]action_msgs/GoalStatus.STATUS_CANCELED[/code].
